limitations: Illustrative tracer directions and gas colors, not mass, pressure, temperature or concentration.
Estimated routes through proxy ports/prechambers; no connected CFD volume is implied.
Valve gates follow illustrative lift; pressure-driven reversal, EGR flow and turbine performance are not solved.
Injection/burn angles are demonstration settings, not verified ABL calibration.
Original estimated reference, not licensed VW OEM CAD or a replacement-parts drawing.
Named major engine systems included; tiny pump/turbo/accessory internals and hardware aggregated or representative.
Water/oil passages, casting surfaces, joint stiffness, fluid loads, clearances and fastener positions are estimates.
No full-assembly interference or as-installed mounting validation. Do not use for repairs or machining.
No combustion pressure, force, vibration, resonance, sound level or noise-source ranking has been calculated.
External vehicle systems stop at named interfaces; they are required later for installed-vehicle NVH.
